standard.said: not on the fees page for an application in Belize; 6-8 weeks from overseas

urgent.service: 24 hours, at the Belmopan headquarters only

note: A lost passport adds BZD 200. A medical emergency passport (BZD 100, five working days) is at the office's discretion. Applying overseas, the fees include shipping and handling and differ by mission. The ordinary processing time in Belize is a lead.

sources.title: immigration.gov.bz, Passport Fees
sources.said: All fees are shown in Belize dollars e-PASSPORTS FEE 10 – year validity e-passport (for persons aged 16 and over) BZ$200.00 5 Year validity e-passport (for children under 16) BZ$150.00 Expedite Service Fees The Nationality and Passports Department offer an expedite service, the services is for a 24 hour. This services is only given at our Belmopan Headquarters office. The price below is in addition to the regular price stated above and a lost fee if applicable. For example, the 24 hours service for a child e-passport is BZ$150.00 (regular price) + BZ$300.00 (expedite service fee) = BZ$450.00 24 hours service fee – BZ$300.00 Medical Emergency e-Passport A medical emergency passport is only issued at our Belmopan Headquarters Office and is approved on the discretion of the passport office. The passport application is processed within five (5) working days. An emergency e-passport fee – BZ$100.00 ... A lost passport fee – BZ$200.00 Applying from overseas Note that applying for a Belize e-Passport from overseas additional administrative fees (shipping and handling fees) are included in the passport fees. A regular e-passport is proceed within 6-8 weeks from date of application.
